# `ext::cli_response` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/cli_response.lani#L4)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Opt-in owned response expansion over a generic Provider<H>, with copied argv, retained paths/raw sources/decoded spans, depth-first frames and stable final views published only on complete success. Provider errors transfer to the caller; Expansion owns its independent storage, with explicit destroy and borrowed-view lifetimes. Portable semantic tests, actual-parser composition and the selected native/resource groups pass on Linux x86_64. The resource group covers 29 reached source allocation failures plus two baselines, live maps/fds and an owned provider error surviving Expansion destruction. These direct receipts are not current Rust-libtest passes. Limits bound engine bytes/counts/work, not exact heap/RSS or provider wall time; there is no file-identity cycle detector or sandbox.
